spans.s: AF2534 विलाप vilāpa Lament; Utters moaning sounds
AT0364 विलूनपक्ष vilūnapakṣa Bird with wings cut off.
AF2535 विलेखनं आत्मानं vilekhanaṁ ātmānaṁ Scratches on his own body
AF2536 विलेखनं परितः vilekhanaṁ paritaḥ Scratches his own body as well as that of the nurse. svādhātryaṅga akasmāt
AF2537 विलेपनं इच्छा vilepanaṁ icchā Fond of applying unguent

SV0315 विलेपी vilepī A rice gruel preparation differing in consistency with Peya. It is more solid than Peya. To prepare Vilepi, 4 parts of water and 1 part of broken rice are taken and boiled till rice is soft.
AF2539 विलोम अधोवायु viloma adhovāyu Retention of flatus
